messages:
Iris: Pinging — I'm drafting a short migration note for the Optimize toolkit: callers are confused about when to prefer MaxBatchMs vs MaxBatchSize when using quant profiles. Opening PR shortly: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/9033
Ben: Solid. Can you include a tiny decision flow: streaming use-case -> prefer smaller MaxBatchMs, non-streaming -> tune MaxBatchSize. Folks like one-line recipes.
Iris: Yup. Plan: add a 4-step recipe and a one-paragraph explanation about how quant profiles affect per-token memory which in turn affects achievable batch size.
Ralph: Please add an explicit example where q8-highmem reduces effective batch from 16->8 on a 24GB GPU and mention checking `redwood.batch_effective_size` metric. Real numbers help triage.
Iris: I'll add that example and a small bash snippet to pull metrics:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://console.redwood.ai/api/metrics?name=batch_effective_size&range=5m" | jq .
```
Anya: Also add a short JS snippet showing how to set per-request prefetch=false and override batching client-wide in the SDK. People copy-paste those.
Iris: Draft JS snippet:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ batching: { enabled: true, maxBatchMs: 8 } });
await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-3', input, prefetch: { enabled: false } });
```
Ben: One more thing: include a small "when to hit support" checklist: repeated OOMs after switching quant, sustained drop in throughput >20%, or streaming stalls >200ms. That helps support severity.
docs-bot: @Iris link-check scheduled on PR open; snippet-linter will run on merge.
Iris: Thanks — planning to push in ~30m and will request reviews from Ben and Anya.
